problem_statement: The xtimer API must provide `xtimer_is_set(const xtimer_t *timer)`, which reports whether a timer is currently set/pending. It must return true for a timer after it has been set and not yet removed, and must return false after the same timer has been removed or is otherwise no longer pending.
